description: Supplements associated with a health condition or goal (e.g. 'insomnia', 'anxiety', 'joint pain'), strongest evidence first. evidence_basis direct rows come from studies of the condition; biomarker_proxy rows are inferred from the supplement's effect on the named proxy_biomarkers (each backed by an effect the Aviado app shows), are hypotheses, and are graded at most D. Only recommendable supplements are listed by default (rows carry intervention_type, entity_type, regulatory_status and recommendable only where they differ from coverage.row_defaults; null fields are omitted); include_non_supplements lists prescription drugs and research compounds too, labelled, as context only. dose is a typical study dose {value, unit}: evidence context, not a dosing recommendation (coverage.dose_note). Partial: absence is not evidence a supplement does not help. A weak or ambiguous condition name returns needs_confirmation with candidate conditions; confirm one and pass its id. Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.

condition.description: Health condition, symptom, or goal (e.g., 'insomnia', 'anxiety', 'brain fog', 'joint pain')

include_non_supplements.description: Also list prescription drugs, research compounds and other non-recommendable entities, labelled (default false)

limit.description: Max supplements to return, ranked by evidence (default: 25, max: 50)

min_grade.description: Minimum evidence grade to include (default: D = all)

name: get_supplements_for_condition
title: Supplements for a condition
